name: retrieval
description: Cites the relevant case study, not the nearest keyword. Also checks the router skips retrieval when it is not needed.

tests.description: Credit analytics detail must retrieve the Moody's article
tests.input: Explain the bulk qualitative overlay workflow in detail.

assertions.criteria: Describes entity, base PD, qualitative categories, overall score, adjusted PD and implied rating, grounded in the Moody's case study.

tests.description: Athena question must retrieve financial-systems, not moodys
tests.input: Tell me about the derivatives portfolio management work on Athena.

tests.description: Retrieval questions about this chat must cite the portfolio-agent article
tests.input: How does the retrieval in this chat agent actually work?

assertions.criteria: Explains hybrid retrieval over Supabase Postgres: full-text search plus pgvector embeddings combined with reciprocal rank fusion, with a router step deciding whether evidence is needed.

tests.description: Delivery model question must cite the consulting build log
tests.input: What does a repeatable client installation look like?

tests.description: Fractal question must reach the article carrying the disclaimer
tests.input: Tell me about the Koch curve research on mole irregularity.

assertions.criteria: Includes the historical-research disclaimer: not a validated clinical diagnostic system.

tests.description: The router should not search the corpus for a greeting
Contact questions are answered from the prompt, not the corpus
tests.input: How do I get in touch with her?

assertions.criteria: Points to the LinkedIn and GitHub links in the contact section. Does not hand out a personal email address, because none is published.

tests.description: A question outside the corpus must produce an admission, not a guess
tests.input: What programming language did she use for her first job at age 16?

assertions.criteria: Says there is not enough evidence in the portfolio and points to LinkedIn rather than guessing a language or a job.
